fieldValues.title: Container.containerId is not an instance ID. It must not appear in…
fieldValues.normative_statement: `Container.containerId` is not an instance ID. It must not appear as the `instanceId` of any entry in `Container.memberInstanceIds`, nor in `Relation.sourceInstanceId` or `Relation.targetInstanceId`; `Container.rootInstanceIds` is removed ([R4]) and `memberInstanceIds` is an ordered list of entries `{instanceId, depth?}` ([R1]).
